items.title: Hong Kong jails former banker over $1.6B false credit, cryptocurrency bribes: Report
items.summary: Former banking official gets four years in prison over false letters of credit and accepting $470,000 in cryptocurrency bribes.

items.title: Coinbase Files to List Single-Stock Perps on Apple, Tesla and Nvidia
items.summary: The filing seeks CFTC approval for contracts giving US traders 24/5 leveraged exposure to individual stocks without ownership.

items.title: Polygon Prepares Permissionless Burn of 100 Million POL
items.summary: Contracts are on testnet and await final Security Council signatures, with later base-fee burns set to become community-callable each quarter, Sandeep Nailwal said.

items.title: Bitcoin reclaims $80,000, Solana and Hyperliquid rally as crypto markets shrug off Clarity setback
items.summary: The moves comes as the SEC and CFTC advance crypto-related rulemaking despite the Clarity Act stalling in the Senate.
